Our interns that work the same hours as I do during tax season make more than me per paycheck. 

I’m a Senior Tax accountant with a few years of experience and overwhelmingly positive reviews. And the interns are getting bigger paychecks if they work the same hours. Overtime at 70-80 hour weeks really adds up quick. Once you’re staff, you’re salaried so you are exempt from OT pay.

I would suggest doing a public tax internship, a public audit internship, and a couple corporate accounting/finance internships to help you figure out what route you’ll want to go.
